entry.title: Exhibition Pavilion, Yad Vashem

groundCutout.basis: Locally expose the two occupied floors and their precisely bounded half of the photographed court. Adjacent pavement and raw terrain imagery remain host context.

buildingCutout.basis: Shared campus Q156591 plus distinct way245190611/native35184617279443. The official Pavilion page places it between Art Museum and Book of Names. The existing PMTiles outline and ordinary campus aerial fix this independent range beside the Art Museum. The large mapped polygon includes the open Square of Hope area: do not fill it with a solid box or roof. Its courtyard/end-wall and curved-stair assignment is a picture-led reconstruction. Internal+X follows the mapped southeast axis; +Z faces southwest toward the curved planted wing. The end-wall portal faces-X into the courtyard. Heading0 bakes the signed axes into model east/south. No invented member Wikidata item; portal/notch/window positions are approximate.

terrainReference.basis: Standard PMTiles and Terrarium supply the retained approach and the shared terrain datum. An open limestone court occupies the photographed inner square. Its two pavement sections meet on the same plane. The mapped road, upper plaza, stair approaches and the original heightfield are retained beyond the two cutout outlines.
